base: Use case: illustration-story. Create a landscape game scene for Éclat 'Le Carnet du Semeur', first passage called Le Sentier des Herbes. A modest newly cleared EARTH FOOTPATH through a temperate forest edge into a distant sunlit plain of tall straw-gold grasses. Eye-level three-quarter perspective. Path starts wide at bottom center and meanders gently to a narrow opening at upper middle. Ancient broad oak trunk and olive leaves at far right edge, low shrubs and a birch at left edge; golden meadow only faintly suggested in the distant opening. Path surface visibly freshly dug compact warm earth with a shallow scraped rut, small rough marker stones along its sides, a few short wood stakes tied with plain plant fibers. Natural handbuilt humble passage, no road pavement, no bridge. This is the completed scene; central path must be entirely clear and readable. Composition 3:2 landscape, full vignette fills most of image with soft irregular brush edges fading to actual transparent background. Fine hand-drawn sepia ink, dry graphite and granular muted watercolor; olive, ochre, warm earth and stone gray; same realistic botanical field-journal painting as Éclat landscapes. Soft light from upper left. No text, no border, no paper panel, no buildings, no people, no tools, no modern material, no symbols, no fantasy elements. Keep the ground along the bottom fully painted; only outer silhouette transparent.
